{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOBGLqvc8AAAABVFcEAg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlvlNzg-mQMA", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlvlN", "number": 7, "title": "Replace obsolete RawGit URLs in the online MMD test", "body": "## Problem

The existing online test and examples still use `cdn.rawgit.com` to load MMD sample assets. Those URLs now return HTTP 404, so `npm test` cannot complete even though the parser itself is working.

The maintained `takahirox/three-mmd-loader` project already solves the same asset-loading problem by pinning the Three.js r171 MMD assets to commit `2898f5b1ba10b1e94174c0a62d072f5f7b80442c` and downloading them from `raw.githubusercontent.com`.

## Expected outcome

Keep the existing online-test approach, but replace the obsolete RawGit URLs with stable, pinned Three.js asset URLs following the approach already used by `takahirox/three-mmd-loader`.

`npm test` should again download the real PMD/VMD/VPD samples and parse them successfully.

## Scope

- Update the online asset URLs used by `test/index.js`:
  - `miku/miku_v2.pmd`
  - `vmds/wavefile_v2.vmd`
  - `vpds/01.vpd`
- Use the same pinned Three.js r171 commit as `takahirox/three-mmd-loader` rather than a moving branch or tag.
- Update matching obsolete `cdn.rawgit.com` references in `Readme.md` and `index.html` so the documented/browser examples remain usable.
- Keep the existing online test behavior and parser coverage otherwise unchanged.
- Follow `three-mmd-loader`'s existing asset source/credit terms where relevant.

Out of scope:

- Redesigning or removing `test:offline`.
- Converting the online test into a different test architecture.
- Adding PMX coverage or unrelated parser tests.
- Dependency upgrades or parser behavior changes.

## Reproduction (when relevant)

1. Run `npm test` on current `master`.
2. The test attempts to download samples from `cdn.rawgit.com`.
3. The download fails with HTTP 404, so the online parser smoke test cannot run.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] `test/index.js` no longer references `cdn.rawgit.com`.
- [ ] The PMD, VMD, and VPD sample URLs are pinned to the same Three.js r171 commit used by `takahirox/three-mmd-loader`.
- [ ] `npm test` successfully downloads and parses the real PMD, VMD, and VPD samples.
- [ ] Matching obsolete RawGit URLs in `Readme.md` and `index.html` are updated consistently.
- [ ] The change does not alter parser behavior, `test:offline`, or unrelated build/test structure.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm run test:offline` continue to pass.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes and the diff contains no unrelated changes.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
